transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. We have the high school's digital music production lab proposal on the agenda today. As we usually do, I'd like to hear from the requesting teacher, our instructional technology specialist, and the business-office manager before I make a final approval decision. The draft proposal requests 10 laptops, a commercial cloud music platform, $8,000 from the general fund, and installation on September 1, 2026. Please go ahead and share any relevant findings you each have.

transcript.text: Dr. Monroe, before you finalize the approval, I need to report my technology review findings. My completed network and privacy review found that the commercial cloud platform requested in the draft proposal cannot be used with student accounts due to privacy and security requirements. The district-managed SoundLab EDU platform is the approved alternative — it requires managed student accounts plus a security configuration record. I closed the technology review ticket this week, but I should note it has not yet been linked to the purchasing request.

I received the grant award notice this week and filed it in the business-office grant folder, but the funding note has not yet been added to the proposal.
